mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO AI_PROCESSING_QUEUE (MSGID, TASK_TYPE, STATUS, `DATA`, ERROR_MESSAGE, RUN_AT, CREATE_DT) VALUES (#{msgId}, #{taskType}, 'PENDING', #{data}, NULL, NULL, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
mapper.select: SELECT MSGID AS msgId, TASK_TYPE AS taskType, STATUS AS status, DATA AS data, ERROR_MESSAGE as errorMessage, RUN_AT AS runAt, CREATE_DT as createDt FROM AI_PROCESSING_QUEUE WHERE TASK_TYPE = #{taskType} AND STATUS = 'PENDING' ORDER BY MSGID LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE AI_PROCESSING_QUEUE SET STATUS = 'PENDING' WHERE STATUS = 'RUNNING'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM AI_PROCESSING_QUEUE WHERE CREATE_DT < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 90 DAY)
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO ALERT_RULE (MSGID, `DATA`, CREATE_DT) VALUES (#{msgId}, #{data}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
